basic_info.description: Steps north of Cortland's village, this custom renovated 2-level, 3BD/3BA home is a rare find. Light and airy living, dining and kitchen spaces open w sliding doors to west-facing decks and lush plantings. Vaulted ceilings, warm wood floors, built in shelving. Sleek reno'd kitchen with ceramic tile backsplash, quartz counters, Wolf range, Bosch dishwasher, and new cabinets. Full bath with Heath tiled accent wall, Koehler cast iron tub, Ann Sacks tiled floors, and floating wood vanity. Two, quiet east-facing bedrooms, one with an en-suite full bath, complete the main level. Downstairs, the sumptuous primary suite w/ HUGE custom walk-in closet, warm wood floors and a luxurious renovated master BA opens to lush garden. Designer primary bath w/ large translucent window, Walker Zanger tiled, heated floors, Ann Sacks mosaic tiled walls, rain shower w/ Ipe floor and towel warmer. A cozy family rm that doubles as a nursery, built-in home office, and a fully decked out laundry rm with Ann Sacks tile and ample storage too! Newer systems. Garage w/ SUV parking and interior access & storage shelves. Steps to playground, library, wine bar, Epicurian Trader, Good Life Grocery, Bernal Hill, and more. Close to tech shuttles, MUNI lines, mins to 101/280. 94 WalkScore. Truly special!
